senses.gloss: f. collect. noun (preced. wds.) washed linen clothes, underwear.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 140a:13">Sabb. 140ᵃ</cite> <he>כסכוסי כ׳</he> ed. (Or Zar. Sabb., end <cite ref="K00646"><he>כיתונא</he></cite>, R. H. quot.

<cite ref="Shabbat 140a:13">ib.</cite> <he>כִּתַּנְיָאתָא</he> pl., Ms. M. <he>כִּיתְוַונְיָיתָא</he>, pl. of <cite ref="K00647"><he>כִּיתּוּנִיתָא</he></cite>; Alf. a. Ash. <cite ref="K00648"><he>כִּיתּוּנְתָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="K01363"><he>כִּתּוּ׳</he></cite>) to rub the starch out of linen underwear; <he>לרכוכי כ׳ וכ׳</he> he intends only to soften the linen &c.
<cite ref="Shabbat 140a:13">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>האי כ׳ וכ׳</he> (Or Zer. l. c. a. Ash. <cite ref="K00646"><he>כיתונא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. for Var. lect.).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:5:4">Y. Snh. II, 20ᶜ</cite> bot. <cite ref="A00947"><he>אותניתיה</he></cite> read: <he>כִּיתָּנִיתֵיה</he> (= <he>חלוקא דכיתנא</he> <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 2:5:4">ib.</cite>) his linen garments.
